hypothese.source: Refresh T2 2026 - Communique complet des resultats T2 2026 (28/07/2026, incluant les etats financiers condenses et les tableaux de reconciliation GAAP/Adjusted detailles) + transcript integral du call T2 2026 (28/07/2026, Olivier Loeillot/Jason Garland, incluant la session Q&A complete) + 8-K/communique de l'annonce de l'acquisition definitive de BioLife Solutions (22/07/2026) + presse financiere specialisee (BioSpace, StockTitan, Citybiz, Yahoo Finance/BigGo, ChartMill) pour la couleur BioLife. Sources primaires completes (communique + transcript) desormais mobilisees pour ce refresh.

epsAdj.basisNote: Adjusted (non-GAAP) - beat net d'environ 18% ; CA quasi in line (ecart <1%, 204.13M$ vs 205.5M$ attendus). L'EPS GAAP, lui, s'est nettement degrade (0.09$ vs 0.26$ au T2 2025), l'ecart GAAP/Adjusted se creusant fortement au T2 - voir EVENEMENTS pour l'analyse de cet ecart.

epsReported.note: GAAP diluted EPS of $0.09 for Q2 2026 (GAAP net income $5.0M vs $14.9M in Q2 2025, when GAAP diluted EPS was $0.26). The collapse is not operational (GAAP operating income roughly flat at $14.0M vs $13.9M): it is driven by an abnormally high one-off GAAP effective tax rate (~65% vs ~18% a year earlier and ~22% normative guidance), not commented on during the call and treated as a discrete non-recurring item in the Omnium model. Source: stockanalysis.com quarterly financials (quarter ended 06/30/2026), consistent with the Q2 press release.

dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: No explicit quarterly figures guided, but a detailed Q3 2026 cadence: revenue expected up slightly sequentially; Q3 to be the lowest adjusted gross margin quarter of the year (mix headwind in H2 vs ~1pt tailwind in H1), with Q4 margin rebounding on volume leverage; OpEx to step up ~$2M per quarter in H2 (sales, R&D and IT/Fit-for-Growth investments, after a non-recurring compensation-cost benefit in Q2), leaving Q3 adjusted operating margin roughly flat vs Q3 2025.
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: FY2026 guidance RAISED at Q2 (adjusted non-GAAP basis, explicitly excluding the unclosed BioLife acquisition and future FX): revenue $813-834M ($824M midpoint, +10-13% reported / +10.5-13.5% organic - a full point of organic added at midpoint, which equals the 12% organic already delivered in H1: 'no acceleration needed' per the CEO) vs $803-833M previously; by franchise: Filtration ~mid-single digit, Chromatography >20%, Proteins mid-teens (raised from low double digits), Analytics at least +25% (raised); adjusted gross margin +110-160bps (unchanged); adjusted operating income $128-134M (margin 15.7-16.0%, +190-220bps, raised 25bps for the second consecutive quarter) vs $124-132M previously; adjusted EPS $2.03-2.09 (midpoint $2.06, +$0.05 vs prior guide, +20% vs 2025); adjusted tax rate ~22% (low end of prior 22-23%), adjusted other income $19M, CapEx 3-4% of revenue; tariffs now assumed to have minimal FY impact (Q2 refund received).
pointsCles: Q2 2026 (call July 28): revenue $204.1M (+12% reported, +13% organic after +11% in Q1; beat ~$2.7M) and adjusted EPS $0.54 vs $0.37 (+46%, beat $0.09); adjusted gross margin 53.9% (+280bps on volume leverage, pricing and mix), adjusted operating margin 16.7% (+460bps, incl. 40bps from the Polymem sale), adjusted EBITDA margin 21.4%, adjusted net income $31M (+45%), cash and securities $810M (+$25M sequentially). GAAP diluted EPS meanwhile fell to $0.09 (GAAP net income $5.0M vs $14.9M) on an abnormally high one-off GAAP tax rate (~65%), never raised in the Q&A - confirming its treatment as a discrete, non-recurring item.

Franchise mix: Proteins exceptional at ~+50% (strength across Purolite OEM, Avitide custom ligands/resins incl. the new AV8/AV9, and growth factors; FY guide raised to mid-teens from low double digits), Analytics +30%+ (SoloVPE PLUS upgrade cycle showcasing product-lifecycle management; FY raised to at least +25%), Chromatography +low double digits against last year's record quarter (OPUS momentum, large-scale column units +18% in H1; FY kept at 20%+), Filtration only slightly up as every 2026 headwind (gene-therapy program, two specific ATF customers, Polymem divestiture) sits in that franchise (FY kept at ~mid-single digit). Geographies: APAC +40% (China +60% in H1, local OEM manufacturing on track for early 2027), North America high teens (~51% of mix), EMEA down mid-single digit on tough comps.

Strong 2027 set-up not yet in revenue: the order momentum that emerged late in Q1 persisted through Q2 across franchises - capital equipment book-to-bill 'significantly above 1', a second onshoring RFP won (a third expected within weeks), ATF orders rebounding (more new programs/customers won in H1 2026 than in all of H1 2025), emerging biotech +high teens for a fifth consecutive quarter, and new modalities +9% ex the gene-therapy headwind with strong book-to-bill. Management expects this backlog to convert into revenue mostly from early 2027, with the two ATF customer headwinds (inventory management at one, site not ready at the other) explicitly expected to normalize in 2027.

BioLife Solutions: definitive agreement (announced 07/22) to fast-track the cell therapy strategy, closing expected Q4 2026 - bio-preservation media supporting 18 commercial therapies, cell therapy ~1/4 of customers' clinical pipelines; accretive to top-line growth, adjusted margin and adjusted EPS (at least $20M synergies and +$0.05 adjusted EPS in year 1, at least $30M and +$0.25 in year 2). FY26 guidance explicitly excludes BioLife; the transformation office's integration playbook is ready for the closing, and the reaffirmed 30% adjusted EBITDA margin target by 2030 stands.

etatsFinanciers.note: Croises : CA T2 204,1 M$ (+12%, +13% organique), adj EPS 0,54$, resultat operationnel GAAP 14,0 M$ vs 34,0 M$ ajuste (ecart amortissements/one-offs conforme a l'ancrage). Guidance relevee (croissance organique 10,5-13,5%, EPS 2,03-2,09$); acquisition BioLife Solutions annoncee.

Cible reaffirmee lors du call T2 2026 : marge EBITDA ajustee de 30% visee d'ici 2030 (CEO, transcript T2 2026). Acquisition BioLife Solutions (annoncee juillet 2026, cloture attendue T4 2026) : accretion EPS ajuste visee a au moins +0.05$ en annee 1, +0.25$ en annee 2 ; synergies de couts visees a au moins 20 M$ puis 30 M$. hypothese.summary: Le T2 2026 confirme la reacceleration organique (+13%, apres +11% au T1) et un beat tres net sur la profitabilite ajustee, mais le fait marquant du refresh est ailleurs : l'annonce le 22/07/2026 d'un accord definitif pour acquerir BioLife Solutions pour ~1.5 Md$, une operation transformante (quasiment le double du CA annuel de Repligen en valeur d'entreprise) qui n'est pas close et n'est donc PAS integree aux adjXXX de ce refresh, mais qui dominera largement la these au prochain cycle.
hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
Bioprocessing consumables platform in confirmed organic reacceleration: +11% Q1, +13% Q2, adjusted operating margin 16.7% (vs 12.0% a year ago), FY26 guidance raised (revenue 813-835M, adjusted EPS 2.03-2.09). The structuring event is the definitive agreement (22/07) to acquire BioLife Solutions - biopreservation leader present in nearly all approved commercial cell therapies - for ~1.5bn EV, nearly twice Repligen's annual revenue, ~64% paid in shares, closing expected Q4 2026.

== THESIS READ ==
- Organic engine healthy and margin inflecting - the standalone thesis needs no M&A to work. Watch: Q3 organic print and margin follow-through.
- BioLife is NOT in the numbers (unclosed, per protocol): omniumND and omniumShares 2027-2030 do not reflect the ~500M+ cash outlay nor the share issuance. A FULL model rebuild is mandatory at closing. Watch: closing timeline/terms; regulatory clearances.
- Guidance discipline is exemplary (initial -> reconducted -> raised, all archived) - the cleanest scorecard anchor chain in the portfolio. Watch: FY26 close vs the 2.01 initial anchor.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
MAJOR METHODOLOGICAL TENSION (documented, deliberate): announced-but-unclosed BioLife excluded from projections while being potentially transformative. Basis mismatch documented: Omnium base keeps intangible amortization/SBC that the company's 'adjusted' excludes (Omnium 1.52 vs guided 2.06 for 2026). Net cash balance sheet (-178M growing to -530M standalone).

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
Standalone: revenue +11%/yr to 1,197M in 2030, EBIT margin 11.2% -> 13.9% (Omnium base), ETR 15% GAAP (credits on thin pretax), interest income ~+9-10M/yr. Published 2025 reconciles at ~0 residual. Watch: BioLife closing (Q4 26) -> rebuild; CDMO capex cycle; China exposure.

== CATALYSTS ==
BioLife closing (Q4 26); Q3 results (Oct); FY27 guidance (Feb) - first combined-entity frame if closed.

ancrages.moteur: Charges de restructuration/inventaire de 47 M$ (FY2024), explicitement quantifiees et qualifiees de non-recurrentes par le management (severance + rationalisation industrielle), retraitees directement dans data.2024 conformement a E5 d-bis pour ne pas polluer la base CAGR automatique du moteur. Inchange ce refresh.

Guidance officielle FY26 RELEVEE au T2 (28/07/2026, hors impact BioLife) : CA 813-835 M$ (vs 803-833 M$ precedemment), resultat operationnel ajuste 128-134 M$ (vs 124-132 M$), EPS ajuste 2.03-2.09$ (vs 1.97-2.05$). Utilisee comme ancrage direct du chiffre d'affaires (omniumCA.2026) au midpoint (824 M$).

FIABILISE ce refresh grace au communique complet T2 2026 (tableaux de reconciliation officiels) : amortissement des intangibles d'acquisition mesure a 19.3 M$ sur le S1 2026 (stable vs 19.3 M$ S1 2025), extrapole a ~39 M$ pour FY26 complet (proche de l'estimation de creation, ~37 M$ - hypothese initiale globalement validee par la donnee reelle). Reste REINTEGRE dans la base propre du modele (E5e), exclu par le management de son Adjusted EPS. omniumEBIT.2026 = resultat operationnel ajuste guide (131 M$ midpoint, guidance relevee) - 39 M$ = 92 M$, soit une marge de 11.2% au lieu des 15.9% suggeres par la guidance Adjusted. Confiance relevee a MOYENNE (S1 mesure, S2 extrapole).

Transformation Office (annonce T1 2026) visant au moins +1pt de marge annualisee cumulee d'ici fin 2027 - integre a une trajectoire d'expansion graduelle de la marge EBIT propre (10.4% 2026 -> 11.6% 2027 -> 14.0% 2030), en plus du levier operationnel normal lie a la croissance du CA. Trajectoire legerement revisee a la baisse en fin d'horizon vs la creation (14.5% -> 14.0% en 2030) compte tenu de la reevaluation a la hausse de l'amortissement recurrent.

Deceleration graduelle de la croissance organique au-dela de la guidance FY26 relevee, vers un regime plus mature (+11% 2027, +10% 2028, +9% 2029-2030) - inchange vs la creation, la reacceleration confirmee au T2 (+13% organique) ne modifiant pas la logique de deceleration progressive a plus long terme en l'absence de guidance explicite au-dela de FY26.
Taux d'imposition normatif de 22.5%, milieu de la fourchette de guidance FY26 (22-23%), reconduit par simplification sur tout l'horizon de projection - inchange ce refresh.

TENSION METHODOLOGIQUE DOCUMENTEE : l'acquisition definitive de BioLife Solutions (~1.5 Md$ EV, annoncee 22/07/2026, cloture attendue T4 2026) N'EST PAS integree aux adjXXX 2026-2030 de ce refresh, en coherence avec la discipline du protocole (seuls les evenements confirmes/clos sont quantifies). Consequence assumee : omniumND et omniumShares ne refletent pas le decaissement cash (~500M$+) ni la dilution actionnariale (~64% de la consideration en actions) attendus a la cloture, ni l'accretion EPS ajuste visee par le management (+0.05$ annee 1, +0.25$ annee 2) ni les synergies de couts (>=20M$ puis >=30M$). Refonte complete requise au prochain refresh des que la cloture est confirmee (ou si le calendrier/les termes evoluent).

Notes convertibles de 600 M$ (1.00%, echeance 2028) supposees refinancees plutot que remboursees cash a maturite - hypothese non confirmee par la societe, potentiellement complexifiee par le financement de l'acquisition BioLife (utilisation de tresorerie existante annoncee pour la partie cash de la transaction, sans nouvelle dette mentionnee a ce stade). A traiter comme un point de vigilance renforce plutot qu'une certitude.

historique.message: Organic reacceleration confirmed (+11% Q1, +13% Q2), adjusted operating margin 16.7% vs 12.0% a year ago, guidance raised (813-835M / adjusted EPS 2.03-2.09, ex-BioLife). The structural event is the 22/07 definitive agreement to acquire BioLife Solutions (~1.5bn EV, ~64% of consideration in Repligen shares, closing expected Q4 26) - NOT integrated in projections per protocol (unclosed); a full model rebuild is required at closing (share count, cash outflow, combined P&L).

epsConsensusHistory.source: Guidance officielle Repligen (Adjusted non-GAAP, relevee au T2 2026, 28/07/2026, communique complet avec tableaux de reconciliation) : EPS FY26 2.03-2.09$ (retenu au midpoint 2.06$, en hausse vs 1.97-2.05$ au T1). EPS FY27 estime par extrapolation d'une croissance ~15% (pas de consensus externe propre et fiable trouve). ATTENTION : cette base Adjusted EXCLUT l'amortissement des intangibles d'acquisition (19.3 M$ au S1 2026 seul, confirme par la reconciliation officielle), les couts d'acquisition/integration/cession, la restructuration, les couts de transformation et la variation de juste valeur des earn-outs - contrairement a la base propre du modele Omnium qui REINTEGRE uniquement l'amortissement des intangibles (omniumEPS.2026 = 1.52$, cf. ancrages) - les deux chiffres ne sont PAS directement comparables. Guidance EXCLUT explicitement tout impact de l'acquisition BioLife (non close a ce stade).
